data.name: Azm
data.gender_notes: Azm is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Azm is derived from the Arabic root 'azama', meaning 'to be steadfast, to be determined, to be resolved, and to be strong'. This name is mentioned in various Hadiths and Sunnahs of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) as a sign of strong character and unwavering faith. The name Azm carries the meaning “Resolution, Determination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azm usually hope their child will grow to embody resolution, determination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes one's commitment to Allah and the journey towards achieving His pleasure.
data.etymology: Azm belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resolution, Determination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azm total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عزم
in_arabic.meaning: العزم يعني التأكيد والتحديد والثبات والشدة والقوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: العزم هو معنى عربي قديم يرمز إلى التأكيد والتحديد والثبات والشدة والقوة، ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف شخصيات المؤمنين الذين أظهروا عزمهم وإصرارهم على الطريق الصحيح. في التفسير الإسلامي، يرمز العزم إلى القرار والاندفاع تجاه هدف محدد، وفي سياق النشاط الاجتماعي، يُستخدم العزم للإشارة إلى التزام وتحديد الأهداف والمسار لتحقيقها، ويستفاد من تعريف العزم أن الشخص العازم هو الذي يركز على ما يريد ويرتديه ويحافظ عليه.

in_urdu.name: عزم
in_urdu.meaning: عزم سے مراد تقديم و تحدید اور ثبات کا عمل ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزم کا لفظ قرآن میں متعدد مقامات پر آیا ہے اور اس کے متعلق تقریبا ہر مقام پر ایک ایسا مفہوم سامنے آتا ہے جس کا مشاہدہ کیا جا سکتا ہے کہ وہ پختہ ارادہ اور قائم ہونے والی نیت ہے جس کے لیے انسان اپنے نفس کو استعانت کے لیے تیار کرے، اس لیے یہ نام اپنے لیے ایک بہترین انتخاب ہے جس سے اس کی ذہانت اور ذہانیت کا اظہار ہوگا اور اس کی ذات پر پائے جانے والے نیک امیتر کا بھی اظہار ہوگا

in_hindi.name: अज़्म
in_hindi.meaning: अज़्म का अर्थ है मजबूती और निश्चितता और स्थिरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़्म शब्द अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है मजबूती और निश्चितता और स्थिरता। इस नाम का चयन करने से बच्चे को जीवन में आगे बढ़ने और अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने की शक्ति मिलेगी। इस्लामिक परंपरा में अज़्म का महत्व बहुत अधिक है, क्योंकि यह शब्द ताकत और प्रतिबद्धता को दर्शाता है।

in_english.name: Azm
in_english.meaning: Azm means determination and firm resolve and strength and power
in_english.long_meaning: Azm is an Arabic name that means determination and firm resolve and strength and power. In Islamic tradition, azm refers to a person's firm resolve and determination to achieve a specific goal. It is a name that symbolizes a person's strength and power, and their ability to overcome obstacles and achieve their goals. The name azm is derived from the Arabic root 'azm', which means 'to be firm' or 'to be strong'. In the Quran, azm is used to describe people who are firm in their faith and determination. In Islamic culture, azm is considered a positive trait that is highly valued.

historical_references.context: Azm bin Marwan Al-Kalbi was a notable companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and one of the earliest converts to Islam. He was known for his unwavering faith and dedication to the cause, hence the name Azm, which means 'constancy' or 'firmness' in Arabic.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hajar al-Haytami's Al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba The name Azm carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azm bin Thabit Al-Ansari was a prominent Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a member of the Ansar (Helpers) of Medina. He was given the title 'Azm' due to his exceptional bravery and steadfastness during the Battle of Uhud.
